design_groups.title: Alirocumab 75 mg Q2W/Up to 150 mg Q2W
design_groups.description: Alirocumab 75 mg SC injection Q2W added to stable LMT for up to 64 months. Alirocumab dose up-titrated to 150 mg Q2W from Month 2 when Low-Density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) levels \>=50 mg/dL (1.29 mmol/L) at Month 1; or if up-titration was missed due to unavailability of LDL-C value, it was up-titrated at month 4 based on LDL-C value at Month 2. For participants receiving 150 mg Q2W, alirocumab dose was down-titrated in a blinded manner to 75 mg Q2W if two consecutive values of LDL-C were \<25 mg/dL (0.65 mmol/L). For participants receiving 75 mg Q2W, alirocumab dose was switched to placebo in a blinded manner if two consecutive values of LDL-C were \<15 mg/dL (0.39 mmol/L).
